title: Withaferin A alleviates inflammation in animal models of arthritis by inhibiting the NF-kappaB pathway and cytokine release.
authors: Alenazi, Fahaad; Moursi, Soha; Mahmoud, Madiha R; Shahid, Syed Monowar Alam; Khatoon, Fahmida; Shahid Khan, Mohd; Khan, Mahmood Ahmad; Alam, Mohammad Jahoor; Saleem, Mohd; Syed Khaja, Azharuddin Sajid
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Withaferin A通过抑制NF-kappaB通路缓解关节炎炎症，仅涉及NF-kappaB作为转录因子的表达检测和简单分子模拟，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Withaferin A, a steroid lactone from Withania somnifera, exhibits anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and antioxidant properties. This study investigated the effects of withaferin A on collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) rats, focusing on NF-kappaB p65 regulation and cytokine release. Withaferin A (50 mg/kg b.wt., orally) or methotrexate (0.25 mg/kg b.wt., i.p., as a reference drug) was given to CIA rats daily for 20 days postarthritis induction. Joints were removed from nonarthritic and arthritic rats to assess the levels of NO, MPO, interleukin (IL)-1beta, IL-6, IL-10, TNF-alpha, COX-2, and NF-kappaB via ELISA. Furthermore, the mRNA expression of IL-1beta, IL-10, TNF-alpha, COX-2, iNOS, and NF-kappaB was also assessed through qPCR. Treatment with withaferin A significantly inhibited the levels of inflammatory cytokines and the transcription factor NF-kappaB; suppressed the expression of IL-1beta, IL-10, TNF-alpha, COX-2, iNOS, and NF-kappaB in the joint tissue of CIA rats; and reduced cartilage and bone destruction, as shown by H&E staining. To confirm the results obtained from biochemical and molecular studies and to determine the molecular target of withaferin A, we performed a molecular simulation of the potential targets of withaferin A, which identified the NF-kappaB pathway as its target. These results suggested that withaferin A effectively attenuated rheumatoid arthritis progression by inhibiting the activation of the NF-kappaB pathway and the downstream secretion of inflammatory cytokines.
abstract_zh: Withaferin A，一种来自睡茄（Withania somnifera）的甾体内酯，具有抗炎、免疫调节和抗氧化特性。本研究探讨了withaferin A对胶原诱导性关节炎（CIA）大鼠的影响，重点关注NF-kappaB p65调控和细胞因子释放。在关节炎诱导后，每日给予CIA大鼠withaferin A（50 mg/kg体重，口服）或甲氨蝶呤（0.25 mg/kg体重，腹腔注射，作为参考药物），持续20天。从非关节炎和关节炎大鼠中取出关节，通过ELISA评估NO、MPO、白细胞介素（IL）-1beta、IL-6、IL-10、TNF-alpha、COX-2和NF-kappaB的水平。此外，还通过qPCR评估了IL-1beta、IL-10、TNF-alpha、COX-2、iNOS和NF-kappaB的mRNA表达。withaferin A治疗显著抑制了炎症细胞因子和转录因子NF-kappaB的水平；抑制了CIA大鼠关节组织中IL-1beta、IL-10、TNF-alpha、COX-2、iNOS和NF-kappaB的表达；并减少了软骨和骨破坏，如H&E染色所示。为确认生化和分子研究结果并确定withaferin A的分子靶点，我们对withaferin A的潜在靶点进行了分子模拟，鉴定出NF-kappaB通路为其靶点。这些结果表明，withaferin A通过抑制NF-kappaB通路的激活及下游炎症细胞因子的分泌，有效减轻了类风湿关节炎的进展。
